workarounds.note: the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it
a heading design kept in the column is clipped at the column's top edge, so the H1 is span: 'page' even in this one-column layout, and the drawing starts at the top of the paper instead of 22 mm down
the opener's drawing does not count towards the height the opener reserves; the italic lead set 6 mm under the drawing does, so the card starts below it without a minHeight
design text lineHeight is a multiple of the size (1 for the title, 1.45 for the lead), never a pt() value
the palette does not reach design-slot colours or bodyText.referenceColor; col() writes the hex beside every paletteId, so the pills, title, lead and folios keep their colours

a list number is centred 0.3 em above the item's first baseline with the canvas 'middle' baseline, so the 26 pt step figures would ride high; numberVerticalOffset (DROP, 2.5 mm) centres them on the step's first two lines
a box's lists.color also recolours its numbered lists when it differs from unorderedLists.color, so the olive dashes are set document-wide in unorderedLists.color and the step numbers stay tomato

the pictogram strip is an inline icon to the left of the checklist's title, not a corner badge: 1.4.1 centres a corner icon on the corner by half its height, not half its width, so the 18.75 mm strip would hang 16.25 mm past the box's right edge
